records.subject: Self-powered finger-temperature-driven identity recognition
records.conditions: Actively discerns biometric characteristics of fingers
records.quote: Here, a finger temperature-driven intelligent identity recognition strategy is presented based on a thermogalvanic hydrogel (TGH) by actively discerning biometric characteristics of fingers.
context_quotes: This self-powered identity recognition strategy is further applied to a smart lock, attaining a more reliable security protection from biometric characteristics than bare passwords.
